analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($76,235.75) vs SMA5 ($72,310.12)/SMA20 ($66,007.44)/SMA50 ($64,844.39) — short/mid-term trend above, indicating bullish position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($66,104.53)/SMA200 ($68,976.6) — above long-term trend, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (27.0%) + current price range in a pullback from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (54.5 → 76.7) — entering overbought, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-56.3529 → 1520.3696) — continuous improvement, signaling bullish trend expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $74,861.87) — approaching upper band, caution zone.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($74,958.57) — support based on pivot and 5-day high.
· Swing resistance ($79,488.17) — resistance based on 5-day/20-day highs, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low maintained) — confirming continuation of uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.77x) — below 5-day average, suggesting potential weakening of upward momentum.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — potential for short-term correction due to RSI overbought entry and subdued volume, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
